name: ITM Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: ITM Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a global manufacturer and supplier of components crucial for secondary (rechargeable) batteries. Its extensive product range includes protective chips, integrated protection modules, battery packs, sensor modules, chip antennas, and touch screen panels, all engineered for use in portable IT and consumer electronics. The company, initially known as ITM Co., Ltd., officially rebranded to ITM Semiconductor Co., Ltd. in April 2005. Founded in 2000, this South Korea-based entity, headquartered in Cheongju, operates as a subsidiary of NICE Holdings Co., Ltd.
